items.name: Iron Sword
items.description: Plain, honest steel's poorer cousin.

items.name: Oak Staff
items.description: A walking stick that learned a few tricks.

items.name: Hunting Bow
items.description: Light and quick to draw.

items.name: Iron Mace
items.description: Favoured by priests who expect trouble.

items.name: Steel Sword
items.description: Balanced, sharp, dependable.

items.name: Runed Staff
items.description: Runes along its length hum when spells are cast.

items.name: Longbow
items.description: Reaches across the field.

items.name: Warhammer
items.description: Heavy enough to end arguments, slow enough to start them.

items.name: Spell Saber
items.description: A blade etched for hands that also cast.

items.name: Mithril Blade
items.description: Light as a feather, keen as a rumour.

items.name: Archmage Staff
items.description: Once belonged to someone very important, or so says the seller.

items.name: Elven Bow
items.description: Strung with something finer than gut.

items.name: Holy Mace
items.description: Blessed at the high altar of Kingshold.

items.name: Sunblade
items.description: A sword that remembers the dawn.

items.name: Staff of Ages
items.description: Every wizard who held it left a little of themselves behind.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: Boiled leather, patched twice.

items.name: Padded Robe
items.description: Warm, quiet, and full of pockets.

items.name: Chainmail
items.description: Rings upon rings; loud but faithful.

items.name: Mage Robes
items.description: Threaded with silver to hold a charge.

items.name: Scout Leathers
items.description: Cut for running, not for standing.

items.name: Plate Armor
items.description: A walking wall.

items.name: Archmage Vestments
items.description: The embroidery is a spell in itself.

items.name: Shadow Weave
items.description: Hard to see, harder to hit.

items.name: Dragonscale Mail
items.description: Scales shed by something you hope is dead.

items.name: Lucky Charm
items.description: A rabbit's foot. The rabbit disagreed.

items.name: Copper Ring
items.description: Turns your finger green and your skin tougher.

items.name: Ring of Vigor
items.description: Warm to the touch.

items.name: Amulet of Focus
items.description: Quiets the mind before a spell.

items.name: Scholar's Pendant
items.description: Engraved with the motto: keep reading.

items.name: Silver-Tongue Brooch
items.description: Merchants lower their prices without knowing why.

items.name: Band of the Fox
items.description: Sly and quick, like its namesake.

items.name: Sage's Locket
items.description: Holds a lock of a very old philosopher's hair.

items.name: Prayer Beads
items.description: Worn smooth by a hundred hands.

items.name: Holy Symbol
items.description: The temple's sign, blessed and bound in silver.

items.name: Saint's Relic
items.description: A knucklebone of a very patient saint.

items.name: Phoenix Feather
items.description: Still warm, years after it fell.

items.name: Crown of Whispers
items.description: Everyone listens to whoever wears it.

items.name: Willowbark Tonic
items.description: Bitter bark steeped in cheap wine. Good for coughs, fluxes and fevers.
items.note: Eases a common sickness by one stage.

items.name: Gravewort Poultice
items.description: The priests' dressing for wounds that will not close.
items.note: Eases rot, sores, lockjaw or plague by one stage.

items.name: Physician's Draught
items.description: A guild physician's mixture, sealed with the guild's wax.
items.note: Eases most sicknesses by two stages.

items.name: Salts of Saint Orla
items.description: Blessed salts for the plague-house and the grave-sick.
items.note: Eases rot, sores, bog fever, plague or the Grey Veil by two stages.

items.name: Smuggler's Theriac
items.description: Forty ingredients, some of them legal. Cures what the black market sells.
items.note: Clears plague, sores, palsy, lockjaw or the Grey Veil outright.

items.name: Nightshade Oil
items.description: A dark oil for a blade's edge. Wash your hands after.
items.note: Coats a blade in battle: a struck foe sickens for 3 turns.

items.name: Wyvern Venom
items.description: Milked from a live wyvern by someone now missing a hand.
items.note: Coats a blade in battle: a struck foe burns with venom for 3 turns.

items.name: Basilisk Bile
items.description: It stiffens whatever it touches, slowly.
items.note: Coats a blade in battle: a struck foe stiffens and weakens for 2 turns.

items.name: Rat-Plague Vial
items.description: Stoppered glass, sealed with wax and a prayer. Throw it, and stand back.
items.note: Thrown in battle: foes sicken and weaken. The thrower may catch it.

items.name: Vial of the Grey Veil
items.description: Grey smoke curls inside the glass, looking for a way out.
items.note: Thrown in battle: foes grey and falter. The thrower may catch it.

items.name: Notched Falchion
items.description: Sharp enough under the rust. The last owner left in a hurry.

items.name: Drowned Man's Staff
items.description: Pulled from a mere with its owner still holding on.

items.name: Dead Man's Hauberk
items.description: Good mail at a third of the price. Mind the stains at the collar.

items.name: Barrow Plate
items.description: Stripped from a barrow-knight. Cheap, and cold to the touch.

items.name: Physician's Robes
items.description: Fine robes, sold once the physician had no more need of them.

items.name: Pawned Amulet
items.description: Silver, still warm from the last neck. The broker will not say whose.

items.name: Drover's Whistle
items.description: One long note and every beast in earshot turns its head.

items.name: Cradle-Charm
items.description: Woven from the first shell the nursery ever hatched.

items.name: Scroll of Warding
items.description: Ink, linen and a very firm opinion about what may come inside.

items.name: Scroll of Gathered Sparks
items.description: Unroll it slowly. The sparks do not like to wait.

items.name: Hammer-Mark Brooch
items.description: Struck with the maker's own die: proof the piece was made well.

items.name: Journeyman's Cuirass
items.description: Every plate was fitted twice, and the second time was to spite the first.

items.name: Whetstone Charm
items.description: Rub it along the edge and the edge remembers.

items.name: Wright's Edge
items.description: Folded, quenched and folded again until the maker ran out of patience, not steel.

items.name: Glimmerstone Ring
items.description: The stone catches a light that is not in the room.

items.name: Enchanter's Wand
items.description: Thin as a reed, humming like a struck bell.

items.name: Alchemist's Satchel
items.description: Twelve pockets, eleven of them labelled. Do not ask about the twelfth.

items.name: Philosopher's Phial
items.description: It holds something that is nearly gold, and refuses to settle the matter.

items.name: Tinker's Spring-Loop
items.description: A coil that has never once been still.

items.name: Gearwork Harness
items.description: Plates on tiny pistons. It clicks when you breathe.

items.name: Facet-Cut Amulet
items.description: Thirty-two facets, and a different future in each.

items.name: Heart-of-Stone Pendant
items.description: The stone is warm. The cutter swore it was cold when he began.

items.name: Oiled Pack-Strap
items.description: Takes the weight where the shoulder can bear it.

items.name: Hidewright's Jerkin
items.description: Cured for a season, sewn in a week, and rarely thanked.

items.name: Tripwire Charm
items.description: A bit of wire and a very long memory for footsteps.

items.name: Springhammer
items.description: It does not swing so much as release.

items.name: Binding Lantern
items.description: Something in it taps, politely, on the glass.

items.name: Soulbound Staff
items.description: The grain is warm. The grain should not be warm.

items.name: Caller's Horn
items.description: Hollow, yellowed and answered from a surprising distance.

items.name: Packmate Harness
items.description: Made to fit a beast, and altered, grudgingly, to fit its keeper.

items.name: Hearth-Spoon
items.description: Burnt black from a thousand pots and better for it.

items.name: Banquet Apron
items.description: Stained with every feast the house has ever held.

items.name: Wayfinder's Compass
items.description: The needle points to wherever you were about to go.

items.name: Surveyor's Mantle
items.description: Sewn with pockets for maps, and maps for pockets.

items.name: Delver's Pick
items.description: Meant for rock. Will, if pressed, consider other arguments.

items.name: Miner's Brigandine
items.description: Riveted plates, and a lamp-hook where a heart ought to be.

items.name: Keystone Charm
items.description: The one stone that all the others lean on.

items.name: Mason's Maul
items.description: Takes down walls, or argues for them, as the day requires.

items.name: Thornbloom Charm
items.description: A pressed flower with a sting in its stem.

items.name: Greenwarden's Cloak
items.description: Moss grows on the north side, whichever way you face.

items.name: Sheaf Talisman
items.description: Bound with the last sheaf of the harvest, for luck.

items.name: Harvest Scythe
items.description: It has cut wheat for forty years and grievances for ten.

items.name: Tally-Chain
items.description: A link for every deal, and none for a bad one.

items.name: Merchant-Prince's Seal
items.description: Press it into wax and creditors forget they were angry.

items.name: Antivenin Locket
items.description: A drop inside for every kind of bite its maker survived.

items.name: Venomfang Dirk
items.description: The blade is grooved. Do not ask what the grooves are for.

items.name: Loaf of Bread
items.description: Crusty outside, warm in the middle, gone by supper.

items.name: Rye Loaf
items.description: Dark, dense and said to keep a week. Nobody has tested it.

items.name: Sweet Bun
items.description: Sticky with honey and gone in three bites.

items.name: Honey Cake
items.description: Dense, golden and a little too sweet to share.

items.name: Meat Pie
items.description: Mostly gravy. The meat is a matter of faith.

items.name: Apple Pie
items.description: Cinnamon and orchard windfalls under a lattice.

items.name: Hard Biscuit
items.description: Travelling bread: it will outlast the traveller.

items.name: Sack of Flour
items.description: Stone-ground, fine and pale. Bakers count in these.

items.name: Sheaf of Wheat
items.description: Bound with a twist of its own straw.

items.name: Sack of Oats
items.description: Porridge for a week, or a horse's good humour.

items.name: Bag of Bran
items.description: What the miller sifts out and the pigs are glad of.

items.name: Strip of Dried Meat
items.description: Chews like a bootlace and keeps like one.

items.name: Smoked Sausage
items.description: Hung over a beechwood fire until it forgot what it was.

items.name: Salt Ham
items.description: A whole leg, cured and heavy. A feast for a week.

items.name: Joint of Beef
items.description: Cut this morning. Cook it by tonight.

items.name: Sack of Bones
items.description: For soup, or for the dogs, or for the bone-carver.

items.name: Fresh Catch
items.description: Silver still, and smelling of the tide.

items.name: Salt Cod
items.description: Stiff as a board and twice as good for a long road.

items.name: Smoked Eel
items.description: Oily, dark and better than it sounds.

items.name: Basket of Oysters
items.description: Pry them open yourself. The merchants insist.

items.name: Sack of Salt
items.description: Worth its weight, which is the whole joke.

items.name: Wheel of Cheese
items.description: Sharp, crumbling and rinded in wax.

items.name: Crock of Butter
items.description: Salted, pale and cold from the cellar.

items.name: Jug of Milk
items.description: Still warm from the cow, if you are quick.

items.name: Pot of Cream
items.description: Thick enough to stand a spoon in.

items.name: Basket of Apples
items.description: Crisp and a little sour, the way they ought to be.

items.name: Punnet of Strawberries
items.description: Red, ripe and bruised if you look at them hard.

items.name: Basket of Pears
items.description: Heavy with juice and wasps.

items.name: Bunch of Carrots
items.description: Orange, earthy and loved by horses.

items.name: String of Onions
items.description: Strong enough to make a knight weep.

items.name: Head of Cabbage
items.description: Round, green and in no hurry.

items.name: Pumpkin
items.description: Big as a helm and about as hollow.

items.name: Sack of Turnips
items.description: Winter's faithful roots.

items.name: Basket of Peas
items.description: Shell them on the road and call it supper.

items.name: Pot of Honey
items.description: Gold, thick and guarded by someone's stings.

items.name: Packet of Seeds
items.description: Beans, mostly. Plant them and hope.

items.name: Rose Cutting
items.description: Thorny, hopeful and slow to forgive.

items.name: Apple Sapling
items.description: In ten years, pies. In one, a stick.

items.name: Bag of Flower Bulbs
items.description: Dormant now; they will have opinions in spring.

items.name: Garden Spade
items.description: An ash handle and a blade that has seen a lot of turf.

items.name: Trowel
items.description: Small enough for a pocket, mean enough for a root.

items.name: Sickle
items.description: A crescent of iron and a harvest's worth of blisters.

items.name: Pruning Shears
items.description: Snips twigs and, in a pinch, ideas.

items.name: Watering Can
items.description: A long spout and a short temper.

items.name: Sack of Feed
items.description: Mixed grain for anything with hooves or feathers.

items.name: Bale of Hay
items.description: Dry, sweet and a month of a horse's patience.

items.name: Milk Pail
items.description: Staved oak and a handle worn smooth.

items.name: Egg Basket
items.description: Woven willow. Do not run.

items.name: Saddle
items.description: Tooled leather and a seat that remembers its rider.

items.name: Bridle
items.description: Bit, reins and a brass boss that catches the sun.

items.name: Saddlebags
items.description: Two deep pouches and a strap for the third.

items.name: Set of Horseshoes
items.description: Four, and nails to hang them.

items.name: Curry Comb
items.description: Rakes out the mud and the gossip.

items.name: Hunting Horn
items.description: One note, carried half a mile.

items.name: Snare Set
items.description: Loops of wire and a patient disposition.

items.name: Skinning Knife
items.description: Curved, light and kept honest on a strop.

items.name: Bundle of Arrows
items.description: A dozen, fletched with goose and true enough.

items.name: Spare Bowstring
items.description: Waxed gut. Carry two.

items.name: Leather Quiver
items.description: Hangs where an arrow can find it.

items.name: Bundle of Pelts
items.description: Fox, rabbit and one that nobody will name.

items.name: Stag Antlers
items.description: A twelve-point crown, mounted on a board.

items.name: Linen Shirt
items.description: Plain, laced and cool in summer.

items.name: Wool Tunic
items.description: Itchy for a week and warm for a decade.

items.name: Travelling Cloak
items.description: Oiled against rain, hooded against everything else.

items.name: Silk Gown
items.description: It moves like water and costs like a field.

items.name: Velvet Doublet
items.description: Slashed sleeves and buttons that mean it.

items.name: Woollen Hose
items.description: Knitted, darned and darned again.

items.name: Wide-brimmed Hat
items.description: Shades the face and hides the hairline.

items.name: Bolt of Linen
items.description: Twenty yards, undyed and untroubled.

items.name: Bolt of Silk
items.description: Imported by the cart, guarded by the roll.

items.name: Skein of Wool
items.description: Spun by someone's grandmother.

items.name: Sewing Kit
items.description: Needles, thread, a thimble and a stern lecture on buttons.

items.name: Leather Boots
items.description: Resoled twice and good for twice again.

items.name: Fine Shoes
items.description: Pointed, buckled and not made for mud.

items.name: Dancing Slippers
items.description: Silk soles and an open invitation.

items.name: Leather Belt
items.description: One buckle, five holes and an honest length.

items.name: Leather Gloves
items.description: Supple and sewn to fit a sword hand.

items.name: Tanned Hide
items.description: Oak-bark tanned, soft as a boot.

items.name: Waterskin
items.description: Stitched and pitched. Tastes of leather, always.

items.name: Bedroll
items.description: Wool inside, oilcloth out; the ground still wins.

items.name: Travel Pack
items.description: A frame, two straps and a lot of buckles.

items.name: Comfrey Salve
items.description: Green, cold and smelling of a clean cut.

items.name: Restorative Cordial
items.description: Sweet, then bitter, then you can stand again.

items.name: Draught of Clarity
items.description: Peppermint, sage and a thought that arrives on time.

items.name: Elixir of Vigour
items.description: Bottled sunrise with a sting of ginger.

items.name: Mana Draught
items.description: Silver-blue and humming faintly.

items.name: Feverfew Tea
items.description: Bitter, steaming and kind to the head.

items.name: Bundle of Dried Sage
items.description: Burned for smoke, steeped for sense.

items.name: Lavender Sachet
items.description: Keeps moths from the chest and nightmares from the bed.

items.name: Comfrey Root
items.description: Knitbone, they call it. Slimy, but it works.

items.name: Bunch of Mint
items.description: Cool on the tongue and rampant in the beds.

items.name: Mortar and Pestle
items.description: Stone bowl, stone club, a lifetime of powders.

items.name: Vial of Quicksilver
items.description: Silver, heavy and wanting to go everywhere at once.

items.name: Lump of Sulphur
items.description: Yellow and loud-smelling. The alchemists love it.

items.name: Drake's-blood Ink
items.description: Red-black and warm when nobody is looking.

items.name: Empty Flask
items.description: Stoppered, clear and ready for something regrettable.

items.name: Quill Pen
items.description: A goose gave it up, in a manner of speaking.

items.name: Pot of Ink
items.description: Oak-gall black and stubborn on cuffs.

items.name: Sheaf of Parchment
items.description: Twenty sheets, scraped and smooth.

items.name: Ream of Paper
items.description: Five hundred sheets of respectable rag.

items.name: Roll of Vellum
items.description: Calfskin, scraped thin. For things meant to last.

items.name: Stick of Sealing Wax
items.description: Red as a promise and twice as binding.

items.name: Signet Blank
items.description: A smooth silver face, waiting for a name.

items.name: Letter of Introduction
items.description: Sealed. It opens doors, or at least a polite crack.

items.name: Primer of Letters
items.description: Hornbook pictures and a very patient alphabet.

items.name: Herbal of the Vale
items.description: Pressed leaves, careful drawings and one fatal misprint.

items.name: Bestiary Folio
items.description: The beasts of the realm, with many exaggerations.

items.name: Bard's Songbook
items.description: Sixty ballads, two of them clean.

items.name: Book of Hours
items.description: Gilt capitals and a ribbon for every saint.

items.name: Treatise on Arms
items.description: Forty stances, illustrated by someone who had never been hit.

items.name: Scroll of Mending
items.description: Read aloud, it closes a cut. Read twice, it is only paper.

items.name: Scroll of Clarity
items.description: A quiet, orderly spell for a crowded head.

items.name: Scroll of Embers
items.description: Warm to hold. Hold it away from the beard.

items.name: Scroll of Light
items.description: A pale glow that lasts as long as you can read.

items.name: Blank Scroll
items.description: Vellum treated for spell-ink. Take care what you put on it.

items.name: Component Pouch
items.description: Feathers, chalk, bat guano and a lot of small bones.

items.name: Rune Stone
items.description: A river pebble carved with one very serious mark.

items.name: Crystal Focus
items.description: A clear point that holds a thought a little longer.

items.name: Map of the Region
items.description: Roads, rivers and a dragon where the surveyor ran out of nerve.

items.name: Sea Chart
items.description: Soundings, shoals and notes in four hands.

items.name: Star Chart
items.description: The sky as it will be, give or take the clouds.

items.name: Brass Compass
items.description: The needle swings, settles and sulks north.

items.name: Spyglass
items.description: Three brass draws and a lens that sees through fog, almost.

items.name: Surveyor's Chain
items.description: A hundred links and a long argument about boundaries.

items.name: Tallow Candle
items.description: Smoky, cheap and honest.

items.name: Beeswax Candle
items.description: A steady flame and a smell of summer.

items.name: Oil Lamp
items.description: A wick, a bowl of oil and a brass handle.

items.name: Flask of Lamp Oil
items.description: Whale or olive, depending on the day.

items.name: Bundle of Torches
items.description: Six pitch-soaked brands. Mind the roof beams.

items.name: Hooded Lantern
items.description: A shutter you can close when the dark is listening.

items.name: Candle Snuffer
items.description: A little brass bell on a stick.

items.name: Dozen Glass Bottles
items.description: Green, thick and stoppered with cork.

items.name: Window Pane
items.description: Bubbled, clear and costing a fortune to cart.

items.name: Hourglass
items.description: Fine white sand and an honest hour.

items.name: Spectacles
items.description: Two lenses, a wire and the end of squinting.

items.name: String of Glass Beads
items.description: Blue, green and sold by the foot.

items.name: Stained-glass Roundel
items.description: A saint in a circle, bright in a window.

items.name: Clay Pot
items.description: Red, round and cracked only a little.

items.name: Water Jug
items.description: Two handles, one spout and a cool belly.

items.name: Stoneware Crock
items.description: Glazed brown and good for pickles.

items.name: Set of Bowls
items.description: Six bowls, five matching.

items.name: Bundle of Roof Tiles
items.description: Fired red and made to shed the rain.

items.name: Wooden Bucket
items.description: Hooped oak, with a rope handle and a drip.

items.name: Three-legged Stool
items.description: Never wobbles. It has no fourth leg to wobble on.

items.name: Ladder
items.description: Eight rungs and a nail you should check.

items.name: Wooden Chest
items.description: Iron-banded, with a lock that mostly works.

items.name: Joiner's Saw
items.description: Fine teeth and a beech handle.

items.name: Carpenter's Hammer
items.description: Claw one side, face the other.

items.name: Bag of Nails
items.description: Square-cut and slightly rusty.

items.name: Mason's Chisel
items.description: Hardened tip, soft head.

items.name: Mason's Mallet
items.description: Oak, round and dented.

items.name: Block of Granite
items.description: Grey, grainy and a day's carry.

items.name: Marble Slab
items.description: White-veined and cold as a verdict.

items.name: Garden Statuette
items.description: A small nymph, only a little weathered.

items.name: Coil of Hemp Rope
items.description: Fifty feet, laid tight and tarred at the ends.

items.name: Bolt of Sailcloth
items.description: Heavy canvas that has argued with weather.

items.name: Barrel of Pitch
items.description: Black, sticky and the reason hulls float.

items.name: Fishing Net
items.description: Knotted by hand, mended by habit.

items.name: Fishing Rod
items.description: Ash, line and a fine philosophical patience.

items.name: Ship's Lantern
items.description: Brass, horn-paned and swung from a hook.

items.name: Cut Garnet
items.description: Deep red and cheerfully faceted.

items.name: Amber Bead
items.description: A thousand years of sap, with a gnat in it.

items.name: Cut Ruby
items.description: A coal that learned to glow.

items.name: Cut Sapphire
items.description: Blue as the deep end of an evening.

items.name: Cut Emerald
items.description: Green fire in a square setting.

items.name: Cut Diamond
items.description: Clear, hard and priced to match.

items.name: Silver Chain
items.description: Finely linked, with a clasp that shuts firmly.

items.name: Gold Band
items.description: Plain, heavy and unmistakably gold.

items.name: Jewel Casket
items.description: Velvet-lined, with a small lock and smaller key.

items.name: Iron Strongbox
items.description: Riveted, double-locked and heavier than it looks.

items.name: Ledger
items.description: Columns of debts, mostly other people's.

items.name: Chunk of Iron Ore
items.description: Red-brown, heavy and full of promise.

items.name: Chunk of Copper Ore
items.description: Green-streaked and softly shining.

items.name: Chunk of Silver Ore
items.description: Dark, dull and worth the digging.

items.name: Sack of Coal
items.description: Black dust and a hearth's good will.

items.name: Iron Bar
items.description: A foot of cast iron, still faintly warm.

items.name: Copper Ingot
items.description: Cast in the smelter's mould, stamped with its mark.

items.name: Steel Bar
items.description: Folded and quenched; the smiths ask for it by name.

items.name: Keg of Ale
items.description: Brown, malty and a sure way to make friends.

items.name: Flagon of Ale
items.description: Cold from the cellar and ready to be regretted.

items.name: Dwarven Stout
items.description: Black as a mine and thick as an argument.

items.name: Flask of Mead
items.description: Honey wine, golden and treacherous.

items.name: Jug of Cider
items.description: Tart, cloudy and an orchard's apology.

items.name: Bottle of Red Wine
items.description: From the south, and the better for the journey.

items.name: Bundle of Hops
items.description: Green cones that make beer bitter, and brewers happy.

items.name: Bar of Soap
items.description: Lye, lard and a hint of rosemary.

items.name: Flask of Bath Oil
items.description: Lavender and a little warmth.

items.name: Linen Towel
items.description: Rough, big and blessedly dry.

items.name: Bathing Salts
items.description: Pink crystals that make a tub into a spa.

items.name: Barber's Razor
items.description: Hollow-ground, honed and unforgiving.

items.name: Horn Comb
items.description: Fine teeth and a rounded spine.

items.name: Hair Oil
items.description: Scented, slick and a menace to pillows.

items.name: Climbing Hook
items.description: Three prongs and a rope-eye. Walls only count if you cross them.

items.name: Tinderbox
items.description: Flint, steel and a lid that fits.

items.name: Trail Rations
items.description: A week of dried meat, hard cheese and hard luck.

items.name: Ten-foot Pole
items.description: For poking things you would rather not touch.

items.name: Set of Lockpicks
items.description: Nine slim steel tools. Intended for clocks, probably.

items.name: Pair of Candlesticks
items.description: Dented and with the previous owner's initials on the base.

items.name: Old Boots
items.description: Worn through but wearable. They remember a longer road.

items.name: Pawned Ring
items.description: Engraved inside, in a hand nobody here can read.

items.name: Votive Candle
items.description: Lit for someone, and burned for luck.

items.name: Vial of Holy Water
items.description: Blessed at the dawn rite. Harmless to the living.

items.name: Pilgrim's Token
items.description: A tin-bright saint on a loop of string.

items.name: Hedge-Warden's Cloak
items.description: Stitched with a hedgerow's patience; thorns catch whatever reaches for it.

items.name: Highwayman's Dirk
items.description: Left in a lane at dusk by someone who no longer needs it.

items.name: Whispering Bow
items.description: The string hums a word, in the wind, that is almost your name.

items.name: Heartwood Jerkin
items.description: Pressed bark from a tree that was old when the road was young.

items.name: Peat-Black Mail
items.description: Dragged from the fen, stained black, and no heavier for it.

items.name: Marsh Lantern
items.description: The light inside leans away from the wind, and toward the dark.

items.name: Fae-Ringed Circlet
items.description: Cold silver, warm at the temple, and it does not like to be taken off.

items.name: Gossamer Vestment
items.description: Spun between moonrise and a long step; it weighs less than the dew on it.

items.name: Rimeblade
items.description: Frost never leaves the edge, and nor does the memory of what it cut.

items.name: Winterfang Cloak
items.description: A frost-wolf's pelt, cured by someone who did not enjoy the work.

items.name: Stormcaller's Maul
items.description: The crag rings when it is swung, and so does your head, a little.

items.name: Eagle-Eye Charm
items.description: A feather in silver; the world is sharper when you hold it.

items.name: Drowned Captain's Cutlass
items.description: Still wet. It always has been.

items.name: Saltwarden's Oilskin
items.description: Waxed for a gale, and good for a few other things besides.

items.name: Warchief's Cleaver
items.description: Notched by a hundred raids and never once cleaned.

items.name: Hollow King's Crown Fragment
items.description: A shard of a dead king's crown. It remembers being obeyed.

items.name: Emberscale Cuirass
items.description: Scales from the throat of a drake that slept on fire.

items.name: Tidecaller Trident
items.description: The drowned god's priests carried it into the water and never carried it out.

items.name: Pearl Locket
items.description: Cold and wet, however dry the hand.

items.name: Stonefather's Rune Maul
items.description: The runes on its head still glow when it is lifted.

items.name: Delvers' Runeplate
items.description: Light for plate, and warm where the runes are.

items.name: Shard of the Unmade
items.description: It is not quite where you are holding it.
